programme_name: NEGATIVE FINDING — la Universitat Oberta de Catalunya no ofrece un máster universitario específico de Inteligencia Artificial
official_status: NEGATIVE FINDING CONFIRMED — no such official title exists. A RUCT term query for 'inteligencia artificial' (accent-stripped, fresh session, all pages) returns no row for Universitat Oberta de Catalunya. UOC's own AI landing page lists only a 'Máster de FP de Inteligencia Artificial y Big Data' (vocational FP, awarded via UOC-FJE, NOT a máster universitario) plus microcredenciales/cursos; its AI-adjacent official masters are titled Ciencia de Datos, Ingeniería Informática and Ciberseguridad y Privacidad.
ruct_url: N/A — none exists. Nearest UOC official titles: Ciencia de Datos RUCT 4316294 (https://www.educacion.gob.es/ruct/estudio.action?codigoCiclo=SC&codigoTipo=M&CodigoEstudio=4316294&actual=estudios), Ingeniería Informática RUCT 3500127, Ciberseguridad y Privacidad RUCT 4317173
notes: Independently re-sourced. Two lines of evidence agree: (1) RUCT register — .masters-search/spain/ruct.py 'inteligencia artificial' returns 40+ titles including UDIT 4318526, UIE 4318468, Universidad de León 4318450, UPF Erasmus Mundus 4318493 and La Rioja 4318615, but zero UOC rows; (2) UOC's own uoc.edu AI programme index, which offers no máster universitario in AI. Caveat on method: the ruct.py '--universidad' mode returned 0 rows for both 'Oberta de Catalunya' and 'Universitat Oberta de Catalunya', so the university-name filter appears not to work in this environment and was NOT relied on; the title-term query and the university's own page carry the finding. Also note UOC's 'Máster de FP' naming is easy to mistake for an official master — it is vocational training, and 'Máster de Formación Permanente' would likewise be a título propio.

application_window_2027: 2027-28 dates NOT PUBLISHED. CONFLICT: a search-index snippet of a URV page gave a different 2026-27 pattern (1st period 17 Nov–17 Dec 2025, 2nd 8 Apr–7 May 2026); the per-degree calendar page fetched directly is the primary source and is the one recorded. No non-EU-specific early round is stated on the calendar page.
notes: RUCT code 4315875 is printed on URV's own Informació acadèmica page — confirmed from the programme site, not just from the register. Register health is good (institutional accreditation renewed 05/05/2026), so a Sept-2027 intake is plausible. This is one of the few records in this batch where the non-EU price is published as an explicit second tariff rather than left to the decree.

institution: CEV — Escuela Superior de Comunicación, Imagen y Sonido (private, part of the AD Education group since 2019)

No RUCT row exists for CEV or for this title; the only 'Máster Universitario en Producción Musical' in the register is UNIR's (RUCT 3500676), a different institution. CEV's own pages say its qualifications are 'homologados por el Ministerio de Educación y Formación Profesional' — that homologation covers its Grado Medio/Grado Superior FP cycles (e.g. Técnico Superior en Sonido para Audiovisuales y Espectáculos), NOT the 'máster', and the words 'máster universitario', ANECA, RUCT and BOE appear nowhere on the site. Consequence for this candidate: no PhD access, no MECES level 3, and ineligible for public postgraduate scholarships.
ects: NOT FOUND — no ECTS figure published on cev.com; the programme is described in clock hours, not ECTS, which is itself consistent with a non-official title
modality: NOT FOUND on the primary site (presencial in Madrid is implied by the campus-based page title 'Máster en Producción Musical Madrid', but no explicit modalidad statement was readable)
language_of_instruction: NOT FOUND — no 'idioma de impartición' statement anywhere on cev.com. Spanish is the overwhelmingly likely medium (Madrid campus, Spanish/Catalan site) but that is an inference, not a sourced fact, and is NOT recorded as a value.
tuition_total_eur: NOT FOUND from a primary source. Aggregator listings (educaweb, emagister, docenzia) state EUR 7,245 for 1,200 hours; per the brief these may be used to discover but never to state a fact, and cev.com publishes no price that could be read.
non_eu_surcharge: NOT FOUND — cev.com states no differential price for non-EU students. Silence is recorded as NOT FOUND, not as 'no'.

notes: TECHNICAL BLOCKER, flag for a human: cev.com serves a JavaScript shell. Four fetches (cev.com/master-en-produccion-musical/, www.cev.com/master-en-produccion-musical/, www.cev.com/curso/master-en-produccion-musical/, www.cev.com/ca/master-en-produccio-musical/) all returned the generic site chrome instead of the programme detail, so ECTS, price, modality, language and dates could not be established from the primary source. This programme needs a human to open the page in a normal browser. The official-status finding does NOT depend on that blocker: it rests on CEV's institutional type and on the absence of any RUCT row, both independently checkable. Programme appears to exist and run, but as a private certificate.

programme_name: Máster Universitario en Análisis de Datos para los Negocios / Master of Science in Business Analytics por la Universidad Ramón Llull
official_status: máster universitario (official; RUCT estado 'Publicado en B.O.E. (TITULACIÓN RENOVADA POR ACREDITACIÓN INSTITUCIONAL)', Nivel MECES 3, Máster RD 822/2021, verificado 11/07/2017, BOE 07/09/2018, acreditación institucional favorable 18/12/2025). ⚠ TRAP: Esade markets at least three different 'Business Analytics' products — this official MSc (full-time, esade.edu/master-of-science), an 'Executive Master in Business Analytics (EMIBA)' awarding an 'Executive Master of Lifelong Learning', and a 'Diploma Ejecutivo in Business Analytics'. The latter two are Universitat Ramon Llull TÍTULOS PROPIOS with no RUCT row, no MECES 3 and no PhD access. Only the full-time MSc is the registered title.
ects: 60 (RUCT: 29 obligatorios + 25 optativos + 6 TFM, 0 prácticas; Esade programme page also states '60 ECTS')
modality: Presencial, full-time — 'One academic year – Full Time', delivered at the Esade Sant Cugat Campus. No online or part-time variant of this official title.
language_of_instruction: "English" (Esade programme page), with 'Optional classes in Spanish, German, French, and Mandarin Chinese' offered alongside. English entry proof required: TOEFL iBT 100 or IELTS 7.0 Academic (waived for native speakers or degrees taught in English).
tuition_total_eur: EUR 39,000 tuition for the full one-year programme, 2027-2028 intake, plus a EUR 150 application fee. (An earlier-indexed figure of EUR 37,500 corresponds to the 2026-2027 intake; the 2027-28 figure fetched from the fees page is the one recorded.) Payable via Flywire; no instalment schedule is published on the page.
tuition_year_of_rates: 2027-28 (Esade's fees page lists this figure explicitly against the 2027-2028 intake — this is one of very few records in this batch with rates already published for the candidate's own target year)
non_eu_surcharge: NOT FOUND — no differential price for non-EU students appears anywhere on the Esade fees page. As a private school Esade charges one tuition irrespective of nationality, but the page is silent on nationality, so this is recorded as NOT FOUND rather than as an affirmative 'no'. Note the practical corollary: at EUR 39,000 there is no public-price mechanism to fall back on, and Esade MSc Excellence Awards (typically 10–50% of fees, average 26% at the last intake) are the main lever.
complementary_credits_required: NOT PUBLISHED IN RUCT for the title (RUCT 'Nº Créditos Complementos Formativos' is null — the register does not carry the row). Applicant level: the Esade admissions page requires only 'A Bachelor's degree or equivalent' with NO professional experience required, plus a standardised test (Esade Admission Test TAE, GMAT ~615 current edition / 660 previous, or GRE ~160/162) and English proof. Pre-programme bridging is named only for OTHER MSc tracks — 'Finance candidates without relevant backgrounds must complete the Pre-Program in Finance (PPF)' — and no equivalent prerequisite is stated for Business Analytics. No credit-recognition / advanced-standing scheme for a 300-ECTS degree is published.
application_window_2027: Nine rolling deadlines published for the cycle feeding the September 2027 start: 1 Oct 2026, 19 Nov 2026, 14 Jan 2027, 18 Feb 2027, 18 Mar 2027, 22 Apr 2027, 13 May 2027, 3 Jun 2027, 1 Jul 2027. CAUTION on labelling: the admissions page's own intake heading was read as 'September 2026 Intake' while the programme page states 'Start Date: September 2027' and the fees page prices the '2027-2028 intake' — the deadline sequence running Oct 2026 to Jul 2027 can only feed a September 2027 start, so it is recorded as such, but the heading discrepancy is flagged rather than resolved silently. Rolling admissions: applying at an early deadline is materially advantageous for a non-EU applicant needing a student visa.
notes: The Esade page does NOT print a código RUCT, so 4316137 was confirmed from the register and by exact title match ('Máster Universitario en Análisis de Datos para los Negocios / Master of Science in Business Analytics por la Universidad Ramón Llull', Universidad Ramón Llull, Cataluña, 60 ECTS) rather than from the programme page itself — the single soft point in this record. This is the only programme in this batch whose start date (September 2027) matches the candidate's target intake and whose tuition is already published for that year.
